title: Ko te Tuatahi ki te Rapu Murunga
intro: Hoki whakamuri ki te wā i mua i te putanga mai o te rā tuatahi, i mua i te haerenga o tētahi tangata ki te whenua. I hangaia tētahi āhua mai i ngā mea tino iti rawa, i whakawhiwhia ki tētahi tūranga i runga ake i ngā anahera, ā, i whakanohoia ki tētahi māra tapu me tētahi whakatūpato mārama. Heoi, i roto i tētahi wā poto, ka mahia he kōwhiringa - he kōwhiringa ka rangona puta noa i te hītori o te tangata. Ko wai tēnei āhua?
clues: I whānau mai ahau i tētahi ara rerekē - i hangaia mai i te puehu o te whenua, ā, i homai he wairua ora ki ahau e te ringa o te Kaihanga.
I homai ki ahau he mātauranga hohonu rawa, ā, miharo ana ngā anahera o runga ki taua mātauranga.
I whakahaua te rangi katoa kia piko ki mua i ahau, ā, ka ngohengohe katoa rātou — engari kotahi anake, i whakakahore nā te whakapehapeha.
I whakanohoia ahau ki tētahi māra tapu, he wāhi e noho ai te whakamarie me te whakarato mutunga kore — engari kotahi te rāhui tino kaha i puritia e au.
I wareware ahau, i paheke ahau, i kore whakarongo - ā, i tino pā ki ahau te taimaha o taku he.
I tahuri ahau ki tōku Ariki me ngā kupu o te ngākau, ā, i whakaae mai Ia ki taku ripeneta, ko Ia hoki te Tino Murunga Hara.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakahaua ngā anahera kia piko ki raro
I whakamataohia, i haumaruhia hoki te ahi nui
I toremi tetahi rangatira whakakake ki te moana
I whakangaromia te ope taua arewhana
trial.answer: I whakahaua ngā anahera kia piko ki raro

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakaaetia te ripeneta e Allah
I horomia e te ika nui
I pāngia te iwi e te pahūtanga nui
I tahuna e te hau werawera
outcome.answer: I whakaaetia te ripeneta e Allah

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
